exclusions: Scoped geometry export, not fabrication readiness or clearance/continuity certification
No legacy previews, inner copper, pours, arcs, component through holes/slots, blind/buried/microvias, paste, silkscreen, netlist/X3 assembly or material/finish/stackup instructions
Mask expansion is an export parameter; all vias untented; no manufacturer rules inferred

Generic bom.csv and placement.csv inventory all components at component origins. populated-bom.csv and calibrated-placement.csv contain the same explicitly populated all-mounting component subset; their stable identity digest is declared separately.

Sourcing identifiers are exact user-entered values and may be unavailable; no stock, procurement, inferred identifiers or vendor certification. The generic top-view marker does not establish universal vendor zero, polarity, tape orientation or manufacturer-specific mounting filters.
